title: CIBOLA Measurement Card
description: Signed measurement credential v0.1 — the CIBOLA score layer over the RFC 9943 substrate. A measurement, NOT a certification. Every number recomputable from published rows.

subject.description: The system being measured. Join on weights/digest, not names — a model NAME is not a model.

id.description: Stable identifier (e.g. HF repo id or local path)

digest.description: Content hash (sha256) of the weights — the real join key

benchmark.description: The benchmark universe the subject was measured against.

digest.description: sha256 of the frozen benchmark corpus

gold_labels.description: URL or ref to the frozen published gold labels

scores.description: Axis -> measured result. Values are the published measurement, never certification.

n.description: Sample size. Nothing quotable below n>=30.

method.description: Deterministic grading vs frozen gold labels; McNemar-primary

measured_count.description: Number of axes actually measured (of total_count)

total_count.description: Total canonical axes (CIBOLA canon = 14; '13 measured of 14' grammar)

exclusion_manifest.description: Which axes are excluded and why — the completeness grammar (e.g. human-baseline DPIA-gated).

hash.description: sha256 of the manifest that was measured

provision_map.description: Jurisdiction-keyed obligation references — the east-west bridge hook. Values cite the provision corpus.

harness_hash.description: sha256 of the exact harness used (harness-trojan demand proof)

credential_register.const: This is a measurement credential. It is not a certification, endorsement, or conformity mark, and must not be presented as one.

signature.description: COSE_Sign1 / Ed25519 envelope (RFC 9943). Added by the signing pod, never by the measuring process.

kid.description: RFC 9679 thumbprint; matches the published did:web key

sig.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical card
